description: This source file implements an iterator for reading and processing compressed bitmap data structures (likely EWAH bitmaps), including functions for initializing, discarding words, and discharging the iterator, with support for boolean negation.

classes.name: rlw_iterator
classes.description: Structure representing an iterator over run-length encoded bitmap data, holding buffer pointers, size, current position, and current run/state.

classes.name: ewah_bitmap
classes.description: Structure representing an Extended Word Aligned Hybrid (EWAH) bitmap data structure.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word in the bitmap buffer, updating internal run-length and literal word counts.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes the iterator from a given EWAH bitmap, preparing to traverse its compressed data.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Discards a specified number of words from the beginning of the iterator, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Outputs words from the iterator into a destination bitmap, with optional negation, up to a maximum number of words.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
